name: @bushizhanghan/dsh-publish-gate
description: Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins: every silent failure in the publish path turned into a deterministic check — package.json completeness, BOM, YAML/JSON parseability, junction and patch insert correctness, npm scope permissions, GitHub repo and token state, market entry format, LICENSE/README, test suite. 发布门禁：把插件发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查。
author: bushizhanghan
